description: Returns the user's saved Suunto routes — at most 5 of them (Suunto's list endpoint ignores limit/offset and appears to return the newest, unverified), so an account with more routes is NOT fully listed; look a route up by id with get_route (ids come from upload_route results, the Suunto app or the route webhook). Each route: id, description, visibility, activityIds, startPoint/centerPoint/endPoint, totalDistance (m), created/modified (epoch ms), watchEnabled. Use export_route for the GPX track. Read-only.
name: list_routes
title: List routes
